insights.one_liner: ARMA has one mid-level design and UX role in Badhoevedorp; the posting describes Arma Group, an Egyptian food manufacturer. No Dutch needed, but it is not a visa sponsor.

culture.text: The posting describes Arma Group, founded in Egypt in 1992, making oils, ghee and other food products with more than 7,000 staff and over 20 brands.
Its one open job here is a mid-level design and UX role in Badhoevedorp.

open.text: It is not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
Its current job here does not require Dutch.

worth_knowing.text: Arma Group is a subsidiary of the Hayel Saeed Anam Group (HSA Group).
